title: TemplateDocument
description: An Epistola template document: a flat graph of nodes (blocks) and slots (named places in a node that hold child nodes), linked by id. root names the one node of type root, whose children slot is the document body. Which component types exist, their slots, properties and applicable styles are defined by the catalog's component registry (contracts/catalog/registry/component-registry.json), with an example per component; the template model guide (https://github.com/epistola-app/epistola-contract/blob/main/contracts/api/docs/template-model.md) walks through a complete letter.

root.description: ID of the root node in the document tree.

nodes.description: Every node of the document, keyed by its id. A node appears in exactly one slot's children, except the root.

slots.description: Every slot of the document, keyed by its id. A slot belongs to the node named by its nodeId and is listed in that node's slots.

type.description: The component type, one of the component registry's types (contracts/catalog/registry/component-registry.json): text, container, columns, table, conditional, loop, stencil, image and so on. It decides which slots, props and styles the node may have.

slots.description: The ids of the slots this node owns, in order. Their names follow the component's slot rules: children for a container, body and else for a conditional, cell-<row>-<col> for a table.

styles.description: Style properties for this node only, CSS-like key and value pairs from the catalog's style registry (contracts/catalog/registry/style-registry.json): marginBottom, fontSize, backgroundColor. They override what the theme and preset supply. Lengths are pt or sp (spacing units of the theme), and some also take %.

stylePreset.description: Names one of the catalog's available block style presets: the presets its manifest declares (catalog.presets) plus those of the catalogs it depends on. The rendering theme's blockStylePresets supplies the styles; a theme that does not style it leaves the block with its own styles only. While a catalog declares no presets, the presets its themes style stand in for the list.

props.description: The component's own properties, as its registry entry declares them: a text node's content (a rich-text document whose expression nodes insert JSONata values from the data), a conditional's condition, a table's rows and columns, a stencil instance's stencilKey and parameterBindings.

nodeId.description: Parent node that owns this slot.

name.description: The slot's name, as the owning component defines its slots: children, column-0, cell-0-1, body, else, fill.

children.description: Ordered child node IDs in this slot.
